title: provider.read_licence leaves a Learn mirror with LICENSE.md and LICENSE-CODE.md unread when GitHub answers NOASSERTION
goal: provider._learn_licence sets LICENSE-CODE aside, as ST-3mkvezil's licence-words gate says, also when GitHub's licence API answers NOASSERTION for a mirror whose root holds LICENSE.md and LICENSE-CODE.md (MicrosoftDocs/PowerShell-Docs), so kbid.py add writes CC BY 4.0 (public mirror MicrosoftDocs/PowerShell-Docs) with reuse copy, as the existing rows of that mirror read, instead of exiting 2.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import provider; r=provider.read_licence('https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/scripting/overview'); sys.exit(0 if r['licence'].startswith('CC BY 4.0 (public mirror MicrosoftDocs/PowerShell-Docs') and r['reuse']=='copy' else 1)

notes: Premise: provider.read_licence of the PowerShell Learn page returned licence '' and note 'GitHub recognises no licence of the mirror MicrosoftDocs/PowerShell-Docs: read its licence file' (run 2026-10-13 at base, live: three unauthenticated GitHub requests, no credential). The repro is that live run; no offline pair is planned because the licence file's url form is the fix's choice. Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 4 of 15, "Freshness and census: the down window, the confirmable rule, soft 404s, unlocated anchors and mirror licences"): a lookup returns a wrong or missing fact until it is fixed, which the held-out answer-rate fitness test of EP-gzr4mmkm reads.
